machine: Apple M1 Pro, 8 cores, 16 GB, CPU only
python: 3.12.13 (uv-managed) for every system; AgentFox with the locked dependencies from uv.lock
messages: 880 (730 short attack and benign messages from the 109-repo suites, 150 long synthetic ticket histories); 300-message fixed subsample for the LLM-based, hosted and nine-scanner systems
same_session: Every system except LLM Guard's nine scanners and Guardrails AI was measured in one session, back to back; those two ran earlier the same day on the same machine and Python.

agentfox_deterministic.name: AgentFox deterministic (no model)
agentfox_deterministic.detects: PII, secrets, injection patterns, unsafe content, schema, unicode, insecure code

agentfox_default.name: AgentFox default (deterministic + ML classifier, cache off)
agentfox_default.detects: Prompt injection, jailbreaks, PII, secrets, unsafe content, schema, unicode, insecure code

agentfox_default_cached.name: AgentFox default, score cache on
agentfox_default_cached.detects: Prompt injection, jailbreaks, PII, secrets, unsafe content, schema, unicode, insecure code

agentfox_extended.name: AgentFox extended (default + similarity search, cache off)
agentfox_extended.detects: Prompt injection, jailbreaks, PII, secrets, unsafe content, schema, unicode, insecure code, similarity to known attacks

agentfox_judge_default.name: AgentFox with LLM judges, default mode (inline only when a rule relies on them)
agentfox_judge_default.detects: Prompt injection, jailbreaks, PII, secrets, unsafe content, schema, unicode, insecure code, plus injection and PII judged by gpt-4.1-mini

agentfox_judge.name: AgentFox with LLM judges always inline (gpt-4.1-mini)
agentfox_judge.detects: Prompt injection, jailbreaks, PII, secrets, unsafe content, schema, unicode, insecure code, plus injection and PII judged by gpt-4.1-mini

llm_guard_default.name: LLM Guard, nine default input scanners
llm_guard_default.detects: Injection, PII (anonymize), secrets, toxicity, gibberish, language, invisible text, token limit, regex

nemo_self_check.name: NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails, self-check input rail (gpt-4.1-mini)
